catalysts.headline: Quoin reported Q3 2026 results: net loss of approximately $4.9 million (vs ~$3.9 million in Q3 2025); cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of approximately $33.2 million as of Sept 30, 2026

Quoin Pharmaceuticals reported Q3 2026 results (quarter ended 2026-09-30): net loss ~$4.9M (vs. ~$3.9M in Q3 2025); nine-month 2026 net loss ~$15.2M (vs. ~$11.5M in 9M 2025); cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities ~$33.2M at quarter-end ($10.1M cash + $23.1M investments), reflecting the August private-placement proceeds. Company reiterated it expects topline data from the Netherton syndrome pivotal trial (CL-QRX003-004) in Q2 2027.
Quoin Pharmaceuticals announced it will provide a corporate update and report Q3 2026 financial results (quarter ended September 30, 2026) before market open on Thursday, November 5, 2026.

Private placement closed: ~$30.8M gross proceeds (~$29.0M net) at closing; accompanying warrants (exercise price $6.10/ADS) could bring total gross proceeds to ~$50.0M if fully exercised. Warrants expire at the earlier of 5 years from closing or 30 days after the company announces the CL-QRX003-004 (Netherton Syndrome) primary endpoint is met. Company states net proceeds, assuming full warrant exercise, are expected to fund operations into H2 2029.
Private placement expected to close on or about this date, subject to customary conditions

Announced securities purchase agreement for private placement of up to ~$50.0M with new and existing healthcare-focused institutional investors (Sirenia Capital, Sphera Healthcare, AIGH Capital, Nantahala Capital, StemPoint Capital, Stonepine Capital) plus company management/board.

Priced a private placement of up to $50.0M gross proceeds: 6,305,300 ADSs (or pre-funded warrants) + warrants for up to 3,152,650 more ADSs, at $4.88/ADS; warrants struck at $6.10/ADS, good for 5 years or 30 days after the CL-QRX003-004 Netherton Syndrome trial primary-endpoint announcement, whichever first; insiders bought ~57,370 ADSs+warrants (~$280K)

Private placement of up to $50.0M gross: ~$30.8M upfront plus up to ~$19.2M on cash exercise of accompanying warrants. 6.31M ADSs (or pre-funded warrants) at $4.88 combined. Expected to close on or about 2026-08-31. Company says proceeds fund operations into H2 2029

FDA cleared Quoin's IND to initiate a Phase 2 study of QRX003 in peeling skin syndrome (PSS); study expected to begin H2 2026, enrolling 6-8 pediatric/adult patients in the US and Europe, targeting a 2028 approval
FDA cleared Quoin's IND application for QRX003 in Peeling Skin Syndrome (PSS), a new indication beyond Netherton Syndrome; Phase 2/3 study planned by end-2026
USPTO issued a Notice of Allowance for a patent covering a QRX003 combination treatment for Netherton syndrome
FDA granted conditional approval of 'QYLEKI' as the proposed brand name for QRX003 (Netherton Syndrome)

conflicts: Reported size of the August 2026 private placement differs by source: one headline cites 'up to $50.0 million' with healthcare-focused institutional investors, while another summary describes net proceeds of about $28 million plus an $11 million ATM facility available for future financing. Could not confirm an exact closing date for this raise, so it is not listed as a separately dated catalyst.

Cash runway guidance differs by source: one analysis says the Q3 2026 update extended the runway into 2028 (from a prior target of 'into 2027'); another describes runway into 'late 2027.' The company's own precise wording was not retrieved.
